_comment: Copy to <workspace>/config.json and edit. That copy is per machine and never committed.
<workspace> is AUDIO_EVENTS_WORKSPACE, else <clone>/../../audio-events if that folder exists, else <clone>/../audio-events. python audio-events/workspace.py prints it.
Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every key is optional; unknown keys are an error.
app: the Fantasynth app checkout (must hold public/music/index.json). --app and FANTASYNTH_APP take precedence.
musicDir: the local music folder the app serves as /local-music/. The LOCAL_MUSIC_PATH environment variable, when set, wins over musicDir; default ~/Music/Live.
tracks: keyed by slug (out/<slug>/). --all on every stage means every slug listed here.
file: the audio file name in musicDir (export_app.py: url of a new track file; measure/seek_formats_prep.py).
appTrack: the app track, public/music/<appTrack>.json (export target; the lyrics stage reads its lyric text).
title: display title, used only when export_app.py creates a track file that does not exist yet (needs file too).
bpm, gridMarker: a hand-measured grid, used only for grid.py's diagnostic comparison, never for fitting.
handTimed: why the track's inline lyrics were timed by hand; the lyrics stage then takes them verbatim and export_app.py --lyrics never overwrites them.
pron: pronunciation fixes for the aligner, {"<token>": "<spelling>"}.
all: false leaves the slug out of every --all (every stage, export_app.py, seek_formats_prep.py); --slug still reaches it. Default true.

track-b.handTimed: word timings fitted by hand; do not align
